original_sentence: What do soccer players and magicians have in common? Both do hat-tricks!
readingExamples: What do soccer players and magicians have in common? Both do hat-tricks!
Why can't Cinderella play soccer? Because she's always running away from the ball.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a game played by two teams of eleven players, using a round ball that players kick up and down the field (called football in British English)
(2) n. (informal) an occasion when this game is played; a match of this sport

posExamples.sentence: The moment the whistle blew, the boy who had been laughed at for his limp tore down the wing, and the whole crowd rose to their feet — for the first time, soccer had made him someone worth watching. （读后续写·励志逆袭）
On behalf of the Student Union, I am writing to warmly invite you to join our inter-class soccer tournament, where teamwork matters far more than the final score. （应用文·邀请信）
Far from being a mere pastime, soccer teaches the young that individual brilliance means little unless it is woven into the collective effort of the team. （议论文·体育与品格）

collocations.example: Every Saturday afternoon, the retired teacher would play soccer with the neighbourhood children, his laughter as loud as any of theirs. （读后续写·温情场景）
The soccer match ended in a dramatic penalty shoot-out that kept fans holding their breath until the very last kick. （读后续写·比赛高潮）
Being chosen for the school soccer team was the proudest moment of his otherwise ordinary year. （读后续写·成长）
Under the floodlights, the empty soccer field seemed to stretch on forever, waiting for the roar of tomorrow's crowd. （读后续写·环境描写）
As a lifelong soccer fan, my grandfather could recall the score of every final he had ever watched. （读后续写·人物刻画）
The soccer World Cup unites billions of viewers across every continent, if only for the length of a single summer. （议论文·体育与全球化）
After months of dawn practice, she finally made the soccer team, proving to everyone — and to herself — that persistence pays off. （读后续写·励志）

synonyms.example: In most of the world outside North America, the game is simply called football, and it stirs a passion few other sports can match. （议论文·文化差异）
synonyms.usage: 英式英语中 football 就指 soccer;美式英语 football 指橄榄球,故写作时须依语境选词,面向国际读者常用 soccer 以免歧义

advancedExpressions.expression: the moment the whistle blew, ...
advancedExpressions.example: The moment the whistle blew, the entire stadium erupted, and thirty thousand voices merged into a single, deafening wave of joy. （以关键动作为时间锚点,瞬间点燃画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to invite you to join our ... , where ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to invite you to join our charity soccer match, where every ticket sold will help a child in need return to the classroom. （邀请信句式 + where 定语从句点明意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being a mere ..., ... teaches us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being a mere game, soccer teaches us that discipline and cooperation triumph where raw talent alone falls short. （先破后立句式,提升论证层次）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was happy to play soccer with his friends.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the ball rolled to his feet and his friends' cheers rang across the pitch, a warmth spread through his chest that no words could capture — this, he realized, was where he truly belonged. （读后续写·心理+环境描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动作触发(the ball rolled to his feet) + 感官环境(cheers rang across) + 心理顿悟(this was where he belonged) + 破折号收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Soccer is good for students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that soccer, by weaving together physical fitness, teamwork and resilience, offers students a lesson no textbook could ever teach. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that...主观点句 + by doing 状语列举三重价值(fitness, teamwork, resilience) + no...could ever 比较级强化

original_sentence: What animal is best at hitting baseballs? A bat!
readingExamples: What animal is best at hitting baseballs? A bat!
definitionEn:
(1) n. a small animal like a mouse with wings that flies and hunts at night
(2) n. a specially shaped wooden stick used for hitting the ball in games such as baseball, cricket or table tennis
(3) v. to hit a ball with a bat, or to take a turn at hitting in cricket or baseball

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 眨（眼）；扇动（睫毛）——常用于 not bat an eyelid/eye 结构，意为“毫不动容、面不改色”
uncommonMeanings.example: When the examiner announced the impossible question, she did not bat an eyelid, calmly picking up her pen as though she had rehearsed this very moment for years. （读后续写·临危不乱·心理刻画）

posExamples.sentence: As dusk deepened over the ruined tower, a single bat swept out of the shadows, its silent wings tracing an eerie arc against the blood-red sky. （读后续写·悬疑环境描写）
Please remember to bring your own bat and a pair of trainers to Saturday's baseball club, as our equipment is limited this term. （应用文·社团通知）
With two runs needed and the crowd holding its breath, the youngest player stepped up to bat, gripping the handle so tightly his knuckles turned white. （读后续写·比赛紧张时刻）
That bats are among the very few mammals capable of true flight is a fact that never fails to astonish students in a biology lecture. （议论文/说明文·自然科普）

idioms.translation: 眼睛都不眨一下；面不改色，毫不惊慌
idioms.example: When accused before the whole class, he did not bat an eye, and his icy composure told everyone that he had nothing to hide. （读后续写·沉着人物）

idioms.translation: 凭自己的努力；主动地（英式口语）
idioms.example: Entirely off her own bat, the girl organised a clothing drive for the flood victims, without waiting for anyone to tell her what to do. （读后续写·主动担当）
Right off the bat, the new coach made it clear that effort mattered to him more than talent. （读后续写·人物登场）

collocations.example: He swung the baseball bat with all his might, and the crack of wood against leather echoed across the empty field. （读后续写·动作描写）
She swung the bat too early, missed completely, and heard the disappointed sigh of her teammates behind her. （读后续写·失误挫败）
Deep in the cave, thousands of fruit bats hung motionless, waiting for the first breath of nightfall. （读后续写·探险场景）
At sunset, a vast cloud of bats poured out of the cave mouth, darkening the sky like living smoke. （读后续写·壮观自然景象）
She batted her eyelashes innocently, but the mischief dancing in her eyes gave her away at once. （读后续写·俏皮人物）

collocations.phrase: be as blind as a bat
collocations.example: Without his thick glasses, Grandpa was as blind as a bat, mistaking the cat for a slipper by the door. （读后续写·幽默细节）

synonyms.example: She wiped the sweat from her brow, adjusted her grip on the racket, and prepared for the decisive final serve. （读后续写·比赛）
synonyms.usage: racket 指网球/羽毛球/壁球等带网面的球拍;bat 指棒球、板球、乒乓球所用的平板球棒/球拍,不可混用

synonyms.example: The golfer selected a club with the care of a surgeon choosing an instrument. （读后续写·专注神态）
synonyms.usage: club 泛指高尔夫球杆或作武器的粗棍;与击球用的 bat 形制、运动皆不同

advancedExpressions.expression: as dusk deepened, a single ... swept out of the shadows
advancedExpressions.example: As dusk deepened, a single bat swept out of the shadows, and an inexplicable chill crept down my spine. （以自然意象暗示情绪转折,制造悬念）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. did not bat an eye, ...
advancedExpressions.example: He did not bat an eye; instead, he folded his arms and met the accusation with a quiet, unshakeable calm. （用习语刻画临危不乱,配 instead 转折加深对比）

advancedExpressions.type: 议论文/说明文·自然科普
advancedExpressions.expression: that ... is a fact that never fails to astonish ...
advancedExpressions.example: That bats navigate flawlessly in total darkness by echolocation is a fact that never fails to astonish us and remind us how much nature still has to teach. （主语从句 + never fail to 双重强调）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He hit the ball with the bat.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He drew back the bat, held his breath for one endless heartbeat, and then swung — the ball soaring over the fence as the crowd exploded into a roar he would never forget. （读后续写·动作分解+高潮）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动作三段分解(drew back / held his breath / swung) + one endless heartbeat 慢镜头 + 破折号引出结果 + 感官高潮(exploded into a roar)

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was not afraid when the teacher scolded her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Even as the teacher's voice thundered across the silent classroom, she did not bat an eyelid, her steady gaze betraying a courage that left everyone, teacher included, quietly impressed. （读后续写·沉着人物）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Even as 让步状语营造压力 + 习语 not bat an eyelid 刻画镇定 + 独立主格(her steady gaze betraying...)补充神态 + teacher included 插入语强化效果

original_sentence: What is the hardest part about skydiving? The ground!
readingExamples: What is the hardest part about skydiving? The ground!
definitionEn:
(1) n. the sport of jumping out of a plane and falling freely through the air before opening a parachute to land safely
(2) n. the activity of free-falling from a great height as a form of recreation or extreme sport

posExamples.sentence: As the plane door slid open and the roaring wind tore at her clothes, she realized that skydiving was not about conquering the sky, but about conquering the fear that had ruled her for years. （读后续写·突破自我）
Our Outdoor Adventure Club is organising a beginners' skydiving experience next month, and I sincerely encourage anyone eager to test their courage to sign up before Friday. （应用文·社团招募）
Skydiving may strike the timid as reckless, yet it embodies a truth worth defending: real growth begins the very instant we step beyond the boundary of comfort. （议论文·冒险与成长）

collocations.example: On her eighteenth birthday, she decided to go skydiving, determined to greet adulthood with a leap of faith rather than a step of caution. （读后续写·成长仪式）
He had always been afraid of heights, so when he finally agreed to try skydiving, his trembling hands spoke louder than any words. （读后续写·克服恐惧）
The skydiving instructor gave her a reassuring nod, and in that single glance she found the courage to let go. （读后续写·关键鼓励）
The skydiving experience left an imprint on his memory far deeper than any photograph could ever hold. （读后续写·难忘经历）
For those first breathless seconds of free-fall, the whole world fell silent, and nothing existed but the rushing air and her pounding heart. （读后续写·极限体验）
After surviving the accident, he took up skydiving, as if daring life to frighten him once more. （读后续写·人物性格）

synonyms.example: Parachuting had once been purely a military skill before it evolved into a thrilling recreational sport. （议论文/说明文·背景）
synonyms.usage: parachuting 强调整个伞降过程,包括开伞后的滑翔;skydiving 更突出开伞前的自由落体与刺激感,写极限运动首选

synonyms.translation: 定点跳伞（从固定物体跳下）
synonyms.example: Base jumping, leaping from cliffs or towers, carries risks that make even seasoned skydivers hesitate. （议论文·风险对比）
synonyms.usage: base jumping 从悬崖、高楼等固定物跳下,高度低、风险更大;skydiving 从飞机跳下,是相对入门的极限运动

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. realized that ... was not about ..., but about ...
advancedExpressions.example: She realized that skydiving was not about defying gravity, but about defying the doubt that had chained her for so long. （not about...but about 句式,由外在动作升华到内在成长）

advancedExpressions.expression: I sincerely encourage anyone eager to ... to sign up before ...
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely encourage anyone eager to embrace a new challenge to sign up for our skydiving experience before the end of the week. （招募/倡议标准句式 + eager to 定语精准锁定读者）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... may strike the timid as reckless, yet it embodies a truth: ...
advancedExpressions.example: Extreme sports may strike the timid as reckless, yet they embody a truth we too often forget: courage is a muscle that grows only when tested. （让步转折 + 冒号引出格言式论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She jumped out of the plane and felt excited.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The instant she flung herself out of the aircraft, the earth spun far below and the wind screamed in her ears, yet beneath the terror surged a wild, intoxicating joy she had never dreamed she could feel. （读后续写·感官+心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The instant 引导瞬时状语 + 环境动词化(the earth spun / the wind screamed) + yet 转折 + beneath the terror surged...倒装凸显心理层次

sentenceUpgrade.original: Skydiving helps people become braver.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By hurling us into the very heart of our fears, skydiving forges a courage that no comfortable classroom could ever cultivate — proof that we grow most where the ground feels least secure. （议论文·观点升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: By doing 状语开篇 + forge/cultivate 动词升级 + no...could ever 强化对比 + 破折号引出格言式收束

original_sentence: You want to start doing exercise? Congratulations! You have just taken your first step towards a new and improved you!
readingExamples: You want to start doing exercise? Congratulations! You have just taken your first step towards a new and improved you!
definitionEn:
(1) n. (congratulations) words that express how pleased you are about someone's success, good luck or happy event
(2) n. the act of telling someone that you are happy about their achievement or good fortune

posExamples.sentence: When her name was finally read out as the winner, a storm of congratulations swept over her, yet all she could see was her mother's tear-streaked face beaming from the back row. （读后续写·荣耀时刻）
On behalf of the whole class, I would like to offer my heartfelt congratulations on your admission to your dream university. （应用文·祝贺信）
A word of sincere congratulation costs nothing, yet it can rekindle the confidence of someone who has struggled quietly and long. （议论文·鼓励的力量）

collocations.example: I am writing to extend my warmest congratulations on your winning the national essay competition. （应用文·祝贺信）
Please accept my heartfelt congratulations — your dedication over these long months has finally borne fruit. （应用文·祝贺信）
Congratulations on passing the exam with such flying colours; no one deserves this success more than you. （读后续写·真诚祝福）
A short letter of congratulation from his former teacher meant more to him than any prize could. （读后续写·温情细节）
Everyone who braved the storm to finish the marathon deserves our warmest congratulations. （应用文·表彰）
Congratulations and best wishes for every triumph that surely lies ahead of you. （应用文·祝贺信结尾）
As messages poured in, she received congratulations from friends she had not spoken to in years. （读后续写·喜悦扩散）

synonyms.example: Her sincere compliment on his handwriting brought an unexpected blush to the shy boy's cheeks. （读后续写·善意鼓励）
synonyms.usage: compliment 是对人品质、外表、能力的当面称赞;congratulation 专用于对方取得成功或喜事时的道喜,场合不同

synonyms.example: The coach's public praise gave the struggling player the courage to keep going. （读后续写·激励）
synonyms.usage: praise 侧重对表现、成就的肯定与表彰,可正式可日常;congratulation 特指为对方的好事、成功道贺

advancedExpressions.expression: a storm of congratulations swept over sb., yet all sb. could see was ...
advancedExpressions.example: A storm of congratulations swept over him, yet all he could see was the empty seat where his father should have been. （用祝贺的喧闹反衬内心的孤寂,以乐景写哀）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to extend my warmest congratulations on ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to extend my warmest congratulations on your remarkable victory, which has brought honour to our entire school. （祝贺信标准开头 + which 非限定从句拔高意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: a word of sincere congratulation ... , yet it can ...
advancedExpressions.example: A word of sincere congratulation costs the giver nothing, yet it can restore hope to a heart on the verge of giving up. （costs nothing...yet 对比结构,论证小善举的大力量）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Everyone congratulated her and she was happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As congratulations rained down from every corner of the hall, a warmth she had never known bloomed in her chest — for in that shining moment, all the sleepless nights and silent tears had finally proved worthwhile. （读后续写·心理+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: rained down 比喻(祝贺如雨) + bloomed in her chest 情感具象化 + 破折号引出因果升华 + 三名词并列(sleepless nights and silent tears)回望艰辛

sentenceUpgrade.original: I want to congratulate you on your success.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: On behalf of the entire student body, I would like to offer you my most heartfelt congratulations on this well-earned success, a triumph that will inspire us all for years to come. （应用文·祝贺信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: On behalf of 代表句式提升正式度 + offer...heartfelt congratulations 惯用搭配 + well-earned 形容词点明实至名归 + a triumph that...同位语从句升华意义

original_sentence: Most people assume that regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind – but what exactly are its health benefits?
readingExamples: Most people assume that regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind – but what exactly are its health benefits?
However, some people assume that if some exercise is good, more is always better.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to think that something is true or probably true without having proof or certain knowledge of it
(2) v. to take or begin to have power, control or responsibility for something
(3) v. (formal) to take on or start to show a particular quality, appearance or manner
(4) v. to pretend to have a feeling, attitude or identity that is not real

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 呈现，具有（某种外观、性质或形态）
uncommonMeanings.example: As the last light drained from the sky, the familiar garden assumed a strange and menacing air, its shadows lengthening into shapes she no longer recognised. （读后续写·环境突变·由熟悉转陌生）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 装出，佯装（某种情绪或神态）
uncommonMeanings.example: He assumed an air of complete indifference, though the trembling of his hands betrayed just how much the news had shaken him. （读后续写·外冷内热·心理反差）

posExamples.sentence: She assumed that the letter, thick and edged in gold, must carry good news, and so she was utterly unprepared for the single grim line that awaited her inside. （读后续写·预期落空·情节反转）
As the new class monitor, I hereby assume full responsibility for organising our weekly reading sessions and ensuring that every voice is heard. （应用文·竞选演讲/职责说明）
We must never assume that silence signals agreement, for the quietest person in the room may well be the one who disagrees most profoundly. （议论文·独立思考）
It is dangerous to assume that hard work alone guarantees success; without direction, even the most tireless effort may lead nowhere. （议论文·努力与方法）

wordForms.noun: assumption (假设，设想); assumer (承担者，较少用)

collocations.example: I wrongly assumed that she had already left, and only later did I learn she had waited for me in the rain for over an hour. （读后续写·误会与愧疚）
The moment his father fell ill, the boy quietly assumed responsibility for the entire family, as if childhood had ended overnight. （读后续写·被迫成长）

collocations.translation: 掌控 / 掌权 / 就职
collocations.example: When she assumed control of the failing club, few believed she could turn its fortunes around within a single year. （读后续写·临危受命）
In the crisis, ordinary volunteers assumed the role of leaders, guiding frightened strangers to safety. （读后续写·平凡英雄）

collocations.phrase: it is (safe / reasonable / wrong) to assume that ...
collocations.translation: ……的假设是（稳妥的/合理的/错误的）
collocations.example: It is reasonable to assume that regular reading broadens the mind, yet reading without reflection yields little true understanding. （议论文·阅读与思考）
Hearing no reply for days, she began to assume the worst, her imagination conjuring one disaster after another. （读后续写·焦虑心理）
He assumed an air of calm, but the tightness around his eyes gave his fear away. （读后续写·强作镇定）
Let us assume, for the sake of argument, that talent is evenly distributed; even then, opportunity would remain the deciding factor. （议论文·假设论证）

synonyms.translation: 推测，假定（更正式，含较强把握）
synonyms.example: I presume you have already read the notice, so I shall not repeat its contents here. （应用文·正式语气）
synonyms.usage: presume 比 assume 更正式,常带有基于合理依据的推断,略显自信甚至冒昧;assume 更中性、日常,单纯指“未经证实地认为”

synonyms.example: Suppose you were in her position — would you have made a different choice? （议论文/口语·设问）
synonyms.usage: suppose 更口语、语气更弱,常用于礼貌请求或设问;assume 强调“想当然地认定”,常暗含缺乏证据的判断

synonyms.translation: 承担；呈现（相当于 assume 的“承担/呈现”义）
synonyms.example: She took on far more work than anyone had asked of her, simply because she could not bear to see the team fail. （读后续写·担当）
synonyms.usage: take on 更口语,可替代 assume 的“承担责任/职务”与“呈现某种样貌”两义;但 assume 更书面正式,议论文与应用文中更佳

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. assumed ..., and so sb. was utterly unprepared for ...
advancedExpressions.example: She assumed the worst was behind her, and so she was utterly unprepared for the phone call that would shatter her fragile peace. （用错误预设铺垫,再以突转制造戏剧张力）

advancedExpressions.expression: I hereby assume full responsibility for ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the newly elected representative, I hereby assume full responsibility for voicing every classmate's concerns to the school. （hereby 增强正式庄重感,竞选/承诺类应用文适用）

advancedExpressions.expression: we must never assume that ..., for ...
advancedExpressions.example: We must never assume that a popular opinion is necessarily a correct one, for history is littered with truths that the majority once dismissed. （否定祈使 + for 引出理由,凸显思辨深度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He thought the news was good, but it wasn't.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He had assumed, with the easy confidence of one who had never known real misfortune, that the news could only be good — and so the blow, when it came, struck him all the harder. （读后续写·预期落空）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: assume with the confidence of...插入语勾勒心态 + em-dash 引出转折 + the blow, when it came 插入语延宕节奏 + all the harder 比较级强化打击

sentenceUpgrade.original: People should not think something is true without proof.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To assume a claim is true merely because it is widely repeated is to surrender one's judgement; genuine wisdom begins the moment we dare to ask, 'But is it really so?' （议论文·思辨升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: To do...is to do 定义式判断句 + merely because 状语揭示谬误根源 + 分号平行结构 + 引语设问收束,启发读者

translation: 创造奇迹，产生神奇效果
original_sentence: Most people assume that regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind – but what exactly are its health benefits?
readingExamples: Most people assume that regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind – but what exactly are its health benefits?
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to have a very good effect on someone or something; to produce excellent or almost magical results
(2) phr. to greatly improve a situation, condition, mood or appearance in a remarkable way

posExamples.sentence: A single word of encouragement from her old teacher did wonders for the girl's shattered confidence, and the very next morning she walked into the exam hall with her head held high. （读后续写·鼓励的魔力）
In my experience, half an hour of morning jogging can do wonders for your concentration, so I strongly recommend fitting it into your daily routine. （应用文·建议信）
A culture of genuine praise, rather than constant criticism, does wonders for a team's morale and unlocks a creativity that fear could never inspire. （议论文·激励与团队）

idioms.translation: 创造奇迹，产生神奇效果
idioms.example: A good night's sleep can work wonders, turning yesterday's despair into today's fresh resolve. （读后续写·状态逆转）

collocations.example: A month by the sea did wonders for his health, colour returning to his cheeks and laughter to his voice. （读后续写·康复）

collocations.translation: 在（做某事）方面创造奇迹
collocations.example: Patience and kindness do wonders in winning over even the most stubborn of hearts. （读后续写·以柔化坚）

(1) n. an illness affecting humans, animals or plants, often caused by infection, that has a specific set of symptoms
(2) n. (medical) a particular named disorder of the body or mind with characteristic causes and effects
(3) n. (figurative) something regarded as a harmful or corrupting condition in society, thought or behaviour

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）社会/精神上的“病症”、恶习、弊端
uncommonMeanings.example: Indifference, he argued, is a disease more dangerous than any virus, for it quietly kills a society's conscience while leaving its body untouched. （议论文·社会批判·比喻）

posExamples.sentence: When the doctor finally named the rare disease that had drained the colour from her father's face, the whole family fell into a silence so heavy that even the ticking clock seemed to hold its breath. （读后续写·家庭变故）
I am writing to invite you to our charity walk, whose proceeds will fund research into childhood diseases and bring hope to families who need it most. （应用文·邀请信）

It has been firmly established that physically active people tend to have stronger immune systems and are at lower risk of disease, which is reason enough to make exercise a lifelong habit. （议论文·健康论证）
Prevention, as every wise doctor knows, is always better than cure, for it is far easier to keep a disease away than to drive it out once it has taken hold. （议论文·预防胜于治疗）

wordForms.other: disease-free（无病的）; heart disease（心脏病）

collocations.example: Active people tend to have better immune systems and are at a lower risk of disease than those who rarely leave the sofa. （议论文·健康）
Doctors warn that a diet high in salt and fat greatly increases the danger of heart disease in later life. （应用文·健康提醒）
Travelling through the flooded villages, the young volunteer feared she might contract a disease, yet she never once considered turning back. （读后续写·志愿者）
Vaccines have helped humanity prevent countless diseases that once wiped out entire communities. （议论文·科学进步）
Simple habits such as washing your hands can stop many diseases from spreading through a crowded school. （应用文·卫生倡议）
During the outbreak of the infectious disease, the whole town pulled together, and neighbours who had never spoken began leaving food on one another's doorsteps. （读后续写·患难与共）
Her grandmother had suffered from a chronic disease for years, yet she greeted every morning with a smile that shamed the healthy. （读后续写·乐观）

synonyms.example: A sudden illness kept him in bed for a fortnight, but the get-well cards from his classmates warmed him more than any medicine. （读后续写·同学情）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：illness 泛指“生病、不适的状态”，强调主观感受，可轻可重；disease 多指“有明确名称、病因的具体疾病”，更医学、更客观。

synonyms.example: The doctor explained that his heart condition would require careful monitoring but need not stop him from living a full life. （应用文·就医说明）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：condition 委婉、正式，常指“需长期管理的慢性病症”（heart condition, skin condition），语气比 disease 柔和，不显严重可怕。

synonyms.example: Sleep disorders are increasingly common among students who scroll on their phones deep into the night. （议论文·作息）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：disorder 侧重“身体或心理机能的失调、紊乱”（如 eating disorder, sleep disorder），未必由感染引起；disease 更常指有病原、可传播的疾病。

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... disease had ..., and ...
advancedExpressions.example: The relentless disease had stolen the strength from his once-powerful hands, yet it could never touch the light that still danced in his eyes. （拟人disease had stolen+转折yet，续写渲染坚韧）

advancedExpressions.expression: to raise awareness of / funds for ... disease, we sincerely invite ...
advancedExpressions.example: To raise funds for research into childhood diseases, we sincerely invite you to join our weekend charity run. （不定式目的状语+invite，邀请/倡议信标准开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as ... prevents disease of the body, ... guards against the diseases of ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: Her grandfather was very ill and the family was sad.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The doctor's quiet diagnosis of the disease fell over the family like a shadow, and for a long moment no one dared to speak, as if silence alone could hold the dreaded word at bay. （读后续写·家庭）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Exercise helps people avoid diseases.

original_sentence: Moreover, exercise is good for your mental health.
readingExamples: Moreover, exercise is good for your mental health.

definitionEn:
(1) adv. (formal) used to add a further, often more important, point to something that has just been said; in addition; besides
(2) adv. used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce supporting information that reinforces a previous statement or argument

posExamples.sentence: The old house was cold and damp; moreover, every creak of its ancient stairs seemed to whisper warnings that made the children huddle closer together in the dark. （读后续写·悬疑氛围）
Our proposed reading club would enrich students' free time; moreover, it would cost the school almost nothing, since the books can be donated by graduates and parents. （应用文·建议信）
Exercise strengthens the body and sharpens the mind; moreover, it teaches the discipline and resilience that no textbook could ever hope to instil. （议论文·运动价值）
Moreover, choosing an activity you truly enjoy will ensure that the exercise you do has a lasting, positive effect on your physical and mental health. （议论文·健康建议）

collocations.translation: 而且；此外（引出更重要的一点）
collocations.example: Moreover, exercise is good for your mental health, lifting your mood on even the gloomiest of days. （议论文·健康）
The plan is affordable, and moreover, it can be launched within a single week. （应用文·方案说明）
Moreover, it will ensure that the exercise you do has a positive effect on your physical health rather than doing more harm than good. （议论文·健康建议）
Moreover, there is growing evidence that green spaces reduce stress and boost concentration in students. （议论文·环境与心理）
Moreover, not only does the programme raise money for charity, but it also brings the whole community together. （应用文·活动总结）

synonyms.example: The new library extends its opening hours until ten; furthermore, it now offers a quiet zone reserved entirely for exam revision. （应用文·通知）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：furthermore 与 moreover 几乎完全同义，都用于书面递进补充；furthermore 略更正式、更强调“进一步、更进一层”，议论文里可与 moreover 交替使用避免重复。

synonyms.example: In addition to raising funds, the charity concert gave shy students a rare chance to shine on stage. （应用文·活动介绍）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：in addition 更中性、更常用，可加 to sth 构成短语（in addition to）；moreover 只作副词、放句首，语气更“郑重地补充一个重要论点”。

synonyms.example: I don't want to go out in this storm; besides, I still have a mountain of homework to finish. （读后续写·日常对话）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：besides 偏口语，常用于对话中补充一个“额外理由”，语气随意；moreover 正式、书面，适合议论文和应用文的严谨递进。

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., moreover, every ... seemed to ...
advancedExpressions.example: The forest was silent; moreover, every shadow seemed to shift the moment she turned her head. （分号+moreover层层加码，续写堆叠悬疑气氛）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., moreover, it would ..., which makes it an ideal choice
advancedExpressions.example: The scheme is easy to run; moreover, it would benefit every year group, which makes it an ideal choice for our school. （moreover递进+which makes定语从句收束，建议信有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: not only ...; moreover, ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: The house was old and it also made scary noises.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The house was old and forbidding; moreover, its warped floorboards groaned with every cautious step, as though the building itself resented the intrusion of the living. （读后续写·悬疑）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分号连接两句 + moreover正式递进 + 拟人(the building resented) + as though虚拟从句渲染阴森氛围

sentenceUpgrade.original: Exercise makes you healthy. It also makes you happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Regular exercise fortifies the body against disease; moreover, it releases the tension of a demanding day, leaving the mind clearer and the spirit lighter. （议论文·健康）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分号+moreover连接双重益处 + fortifies against disease学术措辞 + 现在分词状语(leaving) + 形容词比较级收尾(clearer, lighter)升华

original_sentence: Working out can help you reduce stress and get over negative feelings.
readingExamples: Working out can help you reduce stress and get over negative feelings.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to make something smaller or less in amount, size, degree or number
(2) v. to force someone or something into a specified worse or weaker state or condition
(3) v. to boil a liquid such as a sauce so that it becomes thicker and more concentrated (in cooking)
(4) v. to change a substance to a simpler or more basic form; (in maths) to simplify an expression or fraction

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使沦落到（某种更糟的状态）；使陷入（贫困、泪水等）
uncommonMeanings.example: One heartless remark was enough to reduce the confident girl to tears, and she fled the classroom before anyone could see her trembling shoulders. （读后续写·校园·情感崩溃）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （烹饪）把（汤汁）熬浓、收干
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandma stirred the broth patiently, reducing it over a low flame until the whole kitchen filled with a fragrance that meant home. （读后续写·亲情·厨房记忆）

posExamples.sentence: After weeks of anxious revision, Tom finally discovered that a morning run could reduce the pressure gnawing at him, and he stepped into each exam calmer than ever before. （读后续写·备考·心理疏解）
I am writing to suggest that our school reduce the use of disposable plastic in the canteen, as this small change would greatly lessen the waste we leave behind each day. （应用文·建议信·环保）
Cutting down on screen time will not, by itself, reduce a student's stress; only when we address the real fear of failure behind that stress can genuine relief begin. （议论文·健康与心理·驳论）
Regular aerobic exercise reduces the risk of heart disease and, just as importantly, chases away the low moods that so often shadow a demanding term. （议论文·运动与健康·因果论证）

wordForms.noun: reduction（减少，降低）; reducer（还原剂；缩减装置）
wordForms.adjective: reducible（可减少的，可简化的）; reduced（减少的，降价的）; reductive（简化的，还原的）

idioms.idiom: reduce sb to tears / silence / despair
idioms.translation: 使某人落泪／沉默／陷入绝望
idioms.example: The dying soldier's last letter, read aloud in the crowded hall, reduced even the sternest officers to silence. （读后续写·战争·情感高潮）

idioms.idiom: reduce sth to ashes / ruins / rubble
idioms.example: In a single night the fire reduced the old library to ashes, yet the townsfolk vowed to rebuild it stone by stone. （读后续写·灾难·坚韧重建）
Once a respected merchant, he was now reduced to begging at the very gate where he had once given alms. （读后续写·命运反转·人物落魄）

collocations.example: Ten minutes of deep breathing before bed can noticeably reduce the anxiety that keeps so many students staring at the ceiling at midnight. （应用文·健康建议·倡议）
Doctors agree that a balanced diet reduces the risk of countless illnesses that once seemed simply a matter of bad luck. （议论文·健康生活）

collocations.phrase: reduce the number / amount of sth
collocations.example: By cycling to school, we can each reduce the amount of carbon we send into the air, one small journey at a time. （应用文·倡议书·环保）

collocations.translation: 把……减少了／减少到（某数值）
collocations.example: The new energy-saving lamps reduced the school's electricity bill by nearly a third within a single semester. （应用文·调查报告）
Wearing a helmet significantly reduces the chance of serious injury, a fact no cyclist can afford to shrug off. （议论文·安全意识）
To keep the charity sale affordable, the volunteers found clever ways to reduce costs without lowering quality. （应用文·活动方案）
Simple habits, such as reusing paper and turning off idle taps, can reduce waste far more than most of us imagine. （议论文·可持续生活）
Rather than starving herself, she chose to reduce weight the healthy way, pairing steady jogging with sensible meals. （读后续写·健康·自律成长）

synonyms.example: As the volunteers worked on, the mountain of litter on the beach steadily decreased until the golden sand shone once more. （读后续写·公益·渐进变化）
synonyms.usage: decrease 多指数量或程度自然、渐进地下降，可及物也可不及物；reduce 更强调"人为使之变小"，主动性、目的性更强

synonyms.example: Please lower your voice, she whispered, glancing anxiously at the sleeping baby in the next room. （读后续写·细节·紧张氛围）
synonyms.usage: lower 侧重降低某个"水平／高度／声音"，具体可感；reduce 泛指减少数量或程度，用法更广、更抽象

synonyms.example: The doctor advised him to cut down on salt and late nights if he truly wished to see his grandchildren grow up. （应用文·健康建议·口语化）
synonyms.usage: cut down (on) 为口语短语动词，多指减少某种习惯性的消耗（吃、花、抽等）；reduce 更正式、书面，适用范围更广

synonyms.example: Careful planning helped the organisers minimize the disruption caused by the sudden change of venue. （应用文·活动通知）
synonyms.usage: minimize 强调"降到最低限度"，程度上比 reduce 更极致，常用于风险、影响、损失等语境

advancedExpressions.expression: sth. reduced sb. to ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: The crushing news reduced her to a trembling heap on the floor; yet somewhere deep within, a stubborn spark refused to be put out. （"先崩溃后重燃"的情感弧线，用 yet 制造转折，续写低谷段落）

advancedExpressions.expression: By doing ..., we can effectively reduce ... and thereby ...
advancedExpressions.example: By sorting our rubbish each day, we can effectively reduce the burden on the environment and thereby leave a cleaner city for those who come after us. （by 引导手段+thereby 引出意义，倡议信递进句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: It is not ... that reduces ...; rather, it is ... that ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: Exercise can reduce stress.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There is something almost magical in the way a long run melts away the day's tension: with every pounding step the knots inside slowly loosen, until the stress that once felt unbearable is quietly reduced to a distant hum. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: There is something ... in the way 引出感悟 + with every ... 伴随状语渲染过程 + melt away／loosen 动词化比喻 + reduced to a distant hum 收束点明变化

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should reduce plastic use to protect the environment.

translation: 常规，惯例；一套固定流程

definitionEn:

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （舞蹈、体操、喜剧等的）一套固定动作／表演程式

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 例行的，常规的（不带感情、程序化的）

posExamples.sentence: Every morning before dawn, the old fisherman followed the same unhurried routine — mending his nets, brewing bitter tea, and greeting the sea as one greets an old, unpredictable friend. （读后续写·人物·质朴日常）

idioms.translation: 养成（形成）一套固定的作息或做法
idioms.example: Within a fortnight the new boarding students had fallen into a comfortable routine, and homesickness began, at last, to loosen its grip. （读后续写·成长·适应新生活）

idioms.translation: 打破常规，改变一成不变的生活
idioms.example: Longing to break the dull routine of city life, the family packed their bags and set off for a village where time seemed to move more gently. （读后续写·转折·追寻新生活）

collocations.example: Building exercise into your daily routine is far easier than it sounds: a brisk walk to school already sets your heart beating stronger. （应用文·健康倡议）
When you plan an exercise routine, begin with what your body can honestly manage, then let it grow week by week. （应用文·健身指南·仿课文语境）
A calming bedtime routine — dimming the lights and setting the phone aside — can do more for a restless mind than any sleeping pill. （议论文·健康作息）

collocations.phrase: a change of routine / break from routine
collocations.translation: 换换生活方式，打破日常

synonyms.usage: schedule 强调带具体时间点的"日程表／时间安排"，可临时调整；routine 强调惯常、重复的"做事流程与方式"，更稳定

(3) n. a report or piece of news giving the most recent information about a situation
(4) n. a new or improved version of a piece of software, a product or a document

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使（人）了解最新情况；向……通报进展
uncommonMeanings.example: Before hanging up, the anxious mother begged the nurse to update her the moment there was any change in her son's condition, however small. （读后续写·医院守候·牵挂）

posExamples.sentence: As the storm swept across the valley, the young volunteer crouched over her phone, fingers trembling, and updated the rescue map every few minutes so that the teams below would never lose their way in the dark. （读后续写·灾难救援）

I am writing to inform you that the school library has recently updated its entire collection with hundreds of English readers, and I warmly encourage every student to explore these newly arrived treasures. （应用文·通知）
In an age when a single tap brings us a constant flood of updates, the real challenge is no longer finding information but learning which pieces of it genuinely deserve our attention. （议论文·信息时代）
The moment the coach posted an update on the team notice-board, a cheer rippled through the changing room — the injured captain would, after all, be fit to play in the final. （读后续写·球队·喜讯）

collocations.example: Our workout rooms have been updated with modern equipment, so members can now train exactly as professional athletes do. （应用文·场馆介绍）

collocations.translation: 让某人随时了解最新情况
collocations.example: I promise to keep you updated on the progress of our charity sale, so that no volunteer is ever left wondering how the plans are unfolding. （应用文·倡议书）
Throughout the expedition, the leader sent a daily update to base camp, each message a fragile thread linking the climbers to the world they had left behind. （读后续写·探险）
In a rapidly changing world, those who refuse to update their knowledge will inevitably find themselves left behind by the very progress they once celebrated. （议论文·终身学习）
The teacher handed out an updated version of the schedule, and only then did the students realise how much the timetable had quietly shifted. （读后续写·校园）

collocations.phrase: give sb an update on sth
collocations.translation: 向某人通报某事的最新进展
collocations.example: Could you please give us an update on the preparations for Sports Day, as many parents are eager to know whether the event will go ahead as planned? （应用文·询问信）
A single overlooked software update can leave an entire network exposed, which is why cyber-security experts urge constant vigilance. （议论文·网络安全）

collocations.translation: 就某事向某人通报最新情况
collocations.example: The moment he stepped off the train, his brother rushed forward to update him on everything that had happened during his long months abroad. （读后续写·久别重逢）

synonyms.example: A week among the mountains was enough to renew her weary spirit and send her back to the city with fresh determination. （读后续写·心灵重整）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：renew 侧重“使重新有效/焕然一新”，常用于续订（合同、证件）或恢复精力、决心；update 侧重把旧信息或旧设备“更新到最新状态”，重在“最新”。

synonyms.example: The council's bold plan to modernize the old sports centre transformed a crumbling hall into a facility the whole town could be proud of. （应用文·改造报告）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：modernize 强调整体“现代化改造”，规模较大、较正式；update 既可指整体升级，也可指仅刷新信息，用法更灵活、更日常。

synonyms.example: After the referee raised his concern, the organisers revised the rules to make the competition fairer for every athlete. （议论文·规则修订）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：revise 侧重“检查后修改、修订”文本或计划以改正或改进；update 侧重“加入最新信息”，二者常在文件语境中相邻但重点不同。

advancedExpressions.expression: with every update, sb.'s hope / fear grew
advancedExpressions.example: With every update that flashed across the screen, her hope flickered and grew, until at last the words she had prayed for appeared: he was safe. （重复推进+情感累积，续写扣人心弦的过渡段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am pleased to update you on ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am pleased to update you on the exciting changes our sports centre has undergone this term, changes I am certain every member will welcome. （正式告知句式，通知/说明信开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: in an era of constant updates, ... is more valuable than ever
advancedExpressions.example: In an era of constant updates and endless notifications, the ability to pause, reflect and think deeply is more valuable than ever. （时代背景+价值判断，议论文点题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She updated the map so the team knew the way.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Crouched against the howling wind, she updated the map with numb, trembling fingers, knowing that each tiny mark she added might be the difference between the rescue team finding their path — or losing it forever in the dark. （读后续写·救援·心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 环境描写(howling wind)前置 + 细节动作(numb, trembling fingers) + knowing that分词状语揭示心理与利害 + 破折号制造停顿与张力

sentenceUpgrade.original: We have updated the gym with new equipment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I am delighted to report that our workout rooms have been thoroughly updated with modern, professionally recommended equipment, ensuring that every member — from the seasoned athlete to the first-time visitor — can train in comfort and safety. （应用文·通知）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I am delighted to report正式主句 + 被动语态(have been updated)客观 + ensuring现在分词状语 + 破折号插入范围(from...to...)体现周全

original_sentence: In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options, including modern dance.
readingExamples: In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options, including modern dance.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. as a reaction or reply to something that has been said, asked, or done
(2) phr. as a result of, or in order to deal with, a particular situation, demand or event
(3) phr. (in formal or written contexts) written or acting with reference to a previous letter, request or complaint

posExamples.sentence: In response to the little girl's tearful plea, the gruff old fisherman set down his net, waded into the icy shallows, and gently lifted the stranded seabird into the safety of his weathered hands. （读后续写·善举·情感转折）
In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun new options, and I sincerely hope every member will find a course that suits their taste. （应用文·通知）

In response to the growing concern over screen addiction, some argue that schools should ban phones outright; yet a wiser course, I believe, lies in teaching students to govern the technology rather than fear it. （议论文·观点论证）
In response to your letter of 12 June, I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude for the warm hospitality your family showed me during my stay in London. （应用文·感谢信）

collocations.phrase: in response to public interest / demand
collocations.example: In response to overwhelming demand, the organisers added an extra evening session so that no eager fan would be turned away at the door. （应用文·活动通知）

collocations.phrase: in response to a question / request
collocations.translation: 作为对问题／请求的回应
collocations.example: In response to my nervous question, the interviewer merely smiled and gestured for me to take a seat, and at once my racing heart began to settle. （读后续写·面试）

collocations.phrase: in response to a letter / an email
collocations.example: In response to your kind email, I would be more than happy to share the reading list that helped me fall in love with English literature. （应用文·回复信）
In response to mounting criticism, the school revised its policy overnight, proving that a genuine willingness to listen can turn anger into trust. （议论文·善于倾听）

collocations.phrase: in response to a crisis / an emergency
collocations.example: In response to the sudden flood, hundreds of ordinary citizens formed a human chain along the riverbank, passing sandbags from hand to hand deep into the night. （读后续写·抗洪）

collocations.phrase: act / change / be replaced in response to sth
collocations.translation: 为回应某事而行动／改变／被替换
collocations.example: The old timetable was replaced in response to countless complaints from tired commuters who could no longer bear the endless waiting. （议论文·公共服务）

synonyms.example: In reply to your enquiry about our summer camp, I am delighted to enclose a detailed brochure describing all the activities on offer. （应用文·回复信）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：in reply to 专指对“具体的问题、来信、请求”的直接答复，多用于书信；in response to 范围更广，既可回应言语，也可回应形势、需求、事件。

synonyms.example: In reaction to the shocking news, the whole classroom fell into a stunned, disbelieving silence. （读后续写·突发消息）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：in reaction to 强调“情绪或本能式的反应”，常带自发、即时色彩；in response to 更中性，可指经过考虑后的应对或答复，正式度略高。

synonyms.example: As a result of years of patient training, the once-clumsy boy stood on the podium, a national champion at last. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：as a result of 单纯表“因果”，不含“回应”之意；in response to 隐含“针对某刺激而作出回应/应对”的主动性，二者不可随意互换。

advancedExpressions.expression: in response to ..., sb. did sth, and everything changed
advancedExpressions.example: In response to the stranger's quiet kindness, she finally lowered her guard, and in that single fragile moment everything between them changed. （回应+转折落点，续写情感升温的关键句）

advancedExpressions.expression: in response to your ..., I am writing to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In response to your recent letter, I am writing to offer both my apologies for the delay and my sincere thanks for your patience. （标准应用文开头，回复/致歉信）

advancedExpressions.expression: in response to ..., some argue ...; yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: In response to the pressures of the digital age, some argue that we should switch off entirely; yet retreat, I contend, is no substitute for wisdom. （引出对立观点+转折立论，议论文起承）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The class was changed because people wanted it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In response to the enthusiasm voiced by so many members, our familiar aerobics class has been transformed into a whole range of fresh, exciting options — a change born entirely of your own suggestions. （应用文·通知）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in response to状语前置显因果 + 被动语态(has been transformed)客观 + 破折号补充说明 + a change born of...过去分词短语呼应

sentenceUpgrade.original: She helped the bird because the girl asked her to.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In response to the child's trembling plea, she knelt in the freezing mud without a word, cupped the shivering bird in her palms, and felt something long frozen inside her quietly begin to thaw. （读后续写·善良觉醒）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in response to引出回应动机 + 三个连贯动作(knelt, cupped, felt) + 感官细节(trembling, freezing, shivering) + 隐喻(frozen...thaw)完成内心升华

original_sentence: In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options, including modern dance.
readingExamples: In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options, including modern dance.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to take the place of someone or something, or to do the job that they used to do
(2) vt. to remove someone or something and put a new person or thing in their place
(3) vt. to provide a new one to take the place of one that is old, broken, or lost
(4) vt. to put something back in the place where it was before

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把……放回原处
uncommonMeanings.example: With almost religious care she replaced the faded photograph on the mantelpiece, smoothing its edge as though the smallest crease might disturb the memory it held. （读后续写·睹物思人·怀旧）

posExamples.sentence: When the veteran goalkeeper limped off the pitch, a nervous fifteen-year-old was sent on to replace him, and with that single trembling step his ordinary schoolboy life was left forever behind. （读后续写·临危受命）
In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options, including modern dance, so that every member can find a style they truly enjoy. （应用文·通知）
No matter how sophisticated artificial intelligence becomes, it can never truly replace the warmth of a teacher who notices the quiet child at the back of the room. （议论文·科技与人文）
The company promised to replace the faulty heater free of charge, and their swift, courteous response turned an angry customer into a lifelong supporter. （应用文·投诉回复）

collocations.example: If we replace fear with curiosity, every mistake we make becomes not a defeat but a lesson waiting to be learned. （议论文·成长心态）
In the new syllabus, rote memorisation has largely been replaced by tasks that reward genuine understanding. （议论文·教育改革）
When their beloved captain graduated, no one imagined that the shy new girl would replace her as the very heart of the team. （读后续写·校园）
The crumbling wooden bridge was at last replaced by a sturdy stone one, and the villagers' long years of anxious waiting came to an end. （读后续写·乡村变迁）
A screen full of friends can never replace the simple comfort of a hand resting warmly on your shoulder. （议论文·真实交往）

collocations.phrase: replace a lost / broken / damaged item
collocations.example: I am writing to ask whether it would be possible to replace the damaged book, as I am truly ashamed to return it in such a state. （应用文·致歉信）
In that quiet moment she understood that some things — a mother's patience, a childhood home — are simply irreplaceable. （读后续写·亲情感悟）
Scientists are racing to develop a clean, affordable replacement for fossil fuels before it is too late. （议论文·能源危机）

synonyms.example: With their star striker injured, the coach had no choice but to substitute a raw newcomer, and the whole stadium held its breath. （读后续写·比赛）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：substitute 强调“暂时或临时性地用B顶替A的位置”，尤指体育替补或成分替换（substitute A for B）；replace 更中性，可指永久取代或更换。

synonyms.example: The two friends quietly swapped seats so that the shy new student would not have to sit alone. （读后续写·同学情谊）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：swap 口语化，强调“互相交换”，双方各得其一；replace 是单向的“取代/更换”，被换掉的一方通常被移除或废弃。

synonyms.example: As electric cars steadily supersede their petrol-driven ancestors, the roar of the engine may one day become a sound from history. （议论文·技术更迭）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：supersede 正式且书面，指新事物因更先进而“淘汰、取代”旧事物，含“过时”之意；replace 更普通、日常，适用范围广得多。

advancedExpressions.expression: nothing could ever replace ...
advancedExpressions.example: Medals would come and go, she realised, but nothing could ever replace the quiet pride in her old coach's eyes. （否定强调+价值对比，续写点明真正珍贵之物）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., replacing the outdated ... with ...
advancedExpressions.example: The centre has been thoroughly renovated, replacing the outdated machines with modern, professionally recommended equipment. （现在分词状语说明改进措施，通知/报告）

advancedExpressions.expression: however advanced ... may be, it can never replace ...
advancedExpressions.example: However advanced our machines may become, they can never replace the human capacity for empathy, imagination and moral judgement. （让步状语+never replace，议论文守住人文底线）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The aerobics class was replaced with new options.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In response to the wishes voiced by so many of you, the familiar aerobics class has been replaced with a whole range of exciting new options — from modern dance to boxing — so that everyone can move to a rhythm of their own. （应用文·通知）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in response to状语显因 + 被动语态客观(has been replaced) + 破折号列举(from...to...)增添信息量 + so that目的状语呼应读者需求

sentenceUpgrade.original: A young player replaced the injured captain.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the injured captain was helped from the field, a slight, unknown boy jogged out to replace him — and though his knees shook and his mouth was dry, something in his steady gaze told the crowd that a new story was about to begin. （读后续写·新星登场）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 背景铺垫(as从句) + 外貌与生理细节(slight, knees shook, mouth was dry) + 破折号转折 + 尾句留白设悬念(a new story was about to begin)

original_sentence: We will invite professional athletes to be our coaches.
readingExamples: We will invite professional athletes to be our coaches.
definitionEn:
(1) n. someone who competes in sports, especially in running, jumping or throwing events, or in the Olympic Games
(2) n. a person who is very good at sports or physical exercise, or who is trained in physical activities
(3) n. someone whose profession or main occupation is competing in sports

posExamples.sentence: As the final whistle blew, the exhausted young athlete collapsed onto the track, her chest heaving and her legs trembling, yet through the blur of tears she was already smiling — she had beaten no one but her own weaker self. （读后续写·运动会·自我超越）
We are honoured to announce that professional athletes have been invited to serve as our coaches, so that every member of our sports centre can learn from the very best. （应用文·通知）
A true athlete is remembered not merely for the medals hanging around the neck, but for the discipline, humility and grace displayed long after the cheering crowds have gone home. （议论文·体育精神）
I am writing to recommend Li Hua as our student athlete of the year, for behind his effortless victories lie countless dawns of solitary, uncomplaining training. （应用文·推荐信）

collocations.example: We will invite professional athletes to be our coaches, giving ordinary members the rare chance to train under champions. （应用文·活动介绍）
What sets an elite athlete apart is not raw talent alone but the quiet refusal to give up on the days when no one is watching. （议论文·成功要素）
Though a gifted athlete, she never let praise go to her head, treating each new race as if she still had everything to prove. （读后续写·人物品格）
For six long years he trained as an athlete before dawn, trading warm blankets for cold tracks and easy dreams for a single burning goal. （读后续写·苦练）
The thought that a world-class athlete had once stood exactly where he now stood sent a shiver of determination down his spine. （读后续写·励志）
The spirit of an athlete lies less in winning than in rising, again and again, from every fall. （议论文·体育精神）
Both athletes and coaches gathered in the hall, their faces glowing with the pride of a season hard-won. （读后续写·颁奖）

synonyms.translation: 运动员（不分性别的通称）
synonyms.example: As a devoted sportsperson, she believed that fair play mattered far more than any trophy. （议论文·体育道德）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：sportsperson（及 sportsman/sportswoman）泛指“从事体育运动的人”，也常含“讲体育道德的人”之意；athlete 更偏田径或高水平竞技，专业色彩更浓。

synonyms.example: The young player dribbled past three defenders before slotting the ball calmly into the net. （读后续写·球赛）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：player 侧重“球类、棋类等具体项目的参与者/选手”；athlete 强调体能型竞技者，尤指田径、奥运项目，不用于棋牌类。

synonyms.example: Only ten competitors remained on the track, each one hungry for the single place that led to the finals. （读后续写·比赛）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：competitor 强调“参加比赛、与他人竞争”的身份，中性且宽泛；athlete 强调其“运动员”的职业或专长身份，二者角度不同。

advancedExpressions.expression: like a seasoned athlete, sb. did sth with ...
advancedExpressions.example: Like a seasoned athlete pacing herself for the long climb, she pushed down her panic and moved with slow, deliberate calm. （明喻+比拟，续写用运动员气质刻画人物沉着）

advancedExpressions.expression: invite professional athletes to ..., so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: We will invite professional athletes to be our coaches, so that every member, however inexperienced, may learn from the very finest. （目的状语从句，通知/宣传信亮点句）

advancedExpressions.expression: a true athlete is remembered not for ... but for ...
advancedExpressions.example: A true athlete is remembered not for the medals won but for the courage shown in defeat and the grace shown in victory. （not...but...对比结构，议论文升华体育精神）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The athlete was very tired but happy after the race.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The young athlete sank onto the track, lungs burning and legs like water, yet a fierce, radiant joy blazed in her eyes — for the first time in her life, she had run not to beat others, but to conquer herself. （读后续写·自我超越）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 生理细节(lungs burning, legs like water) + 情感对比(exhausted yet joyful) + 破折号引出主题 + not...but...揭示成长内核

sentenceUpgrade.original: We will invite professional athletes to coach us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I am thrilled to announce that a number of professional athletes have generously agreed to join us as coaches, offering ordinary members the once-in-a-lifetime chance to be guided by true champions. （应用文·通知）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I am thrilled to announce热情主句 + 被动/完成体(have agreed)增可信度 + offering现在分词状语延伸 + once-in-a-lifetime highlight价值

sub_section: B2: Review of the sports centre
original_sentence: A whole new range of courses have been designed for people of all ages, including tai chi and boxing!
readingExamples: A whole new range of courses have been designed for people of all ages, including tai chi and boxing!
definitionEn:
(1) n. the sport of fighting with the fists, usually wearing thick leather gloves, in a roped square called a ring
(2) n. the activity of training with boxing techniques for fitness, self-defence or competition
(3) n. (as a modifier) relating to the sport of boxing, e.g. boxing gloves, a boxing match, a boxing ring

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （Boxing Day，圣诞次日）节礼日（12月26日，英式）
uncommonMeanings.example: On Boxing Day the whole family squeezed onto the sofa, plates of leftover turkey balanced on their knees, and for once no one was in any hurry to go anywhere at all. （读后续写·英国家庭·节日温情）

posExamples.sentence: The first time he stepped into the boxing ring, the roar of the crowd faded to a distant hum, and there was nothing left in the world but his pounding heart, his aching fists, and the towering opponent in front of him. （读后续写·首次上场）
A whole new range of courses has been designed for people of all ages, including tai chi and boxing, and I sincerely encourage everyone to try a sport that once seemed beyond their reach. （应用文·通知）
Far from being mere violence, boxing at its best teaches discipline, respect and self-control — qualities that serve a young person far beyond the ropes of any ring. （议论文·体育价值）
I would strongly recommend our new boxing class to any member who longs to build both physical strength and inner confidence in a single hour a week. （应用文·推荐信）

collocations.example: The whole town crowded into the hall to watch the boxing match, their cheers shaking the rafters with every thundering blow. （读后续写·比赛现场）
Stepping into the boxing ring for the first time, she felt her knees weaken, yet somewhere deep inside a small, stubborn voice refused to let her turn back. （读后续写·勇气）
He laced up his worn boxing gloves with trembling fingers, each strap a silent promise that tonight he would not disappoint his late father. （读后续写·传承）
The coach, who had once been a boxing champion, was as patient with beginners as he was fierce in the ring. （读后续写·人物）
After years of being bullied, the timid boy quietly took up boxing, and month by month the fear in his eyes gave way to a quiet, unshakable calm. （读后续写·蜕变）
Our new boxing class has proved so popular that we have added a second evening session in response to overwhelming demand. （应用文·通知）
Every morning before dawn the old man practised shadow boxing in the empty park, his slow, precise movements a kind of moving meditation. （读后续写·晨练）

synonyms.example: Unlike boxing, wrestling relies less on striking than on grip, balance and the patient art of throwing an opponent off his feet. （议论文·运动比较）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：wrestling（摔跤）靠抓握、摔投取胜，不用拳击打；boxing（拳击）以拳头击打为核心。二者同为格斗项目但规则、技术截然不同。

synonyms.example: In their evening sparring sessions the two friends learned as much about trust as about technique. （读后续写·训练）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：sparring 特指拳击/格斗中“戴护具的对练、试打”，是训练环节；boxing 是整个运动项目，sparring 是其中的一部分。

advancedExpressions.expression: stepping into the boxing ring, sb. felt ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: Stepping into the boxing ring at last, she felt her whole body shake, yet with the first bell something braver than fear rose up to meet the fight. （分词状语+yet转折，续写恐惧到勇气的转变）

advancedExpressions.expression: a whole new range of courses ..., including ... and boxing

posExamples.sentence: Watching her grandmother turn scraps of worn cloth into a dazzling quilt, the girl felt a sudden rush of inspiration, and her fingers began to itch for a needle of her own. （读后续写·祖孙传承·创作冲动）

collocations.example: The young designer drew inspiration from the sweeping curves of ancient temple roofs, weaving tradition into every modern line. （读后续写·艺术创作）
For generations of readers, the quiet courage of ordinary people has remained an endless source of inspiration. （议论文·文学价值）
Despite losing his sight, the marathon runner became an inspiration to everyone who had ever thought of giving up. （读后续写·励志人物）
Whenever her writing stalled, she would walk along the river, seeking inspiration in the rhythm of the flowing water. （读后续写·写作困境）

collocations.translation: 灵光一闪，突如其来的灵感
collocations.example: In a sudden flash of inspiration, he realised that the very obstacle blocking his path could be turned into a bridge. （读后续写·顿悟时刻）
The exhibition of student inventions gave younger children fresh inspiration to dream beyond the classroom. （应用文·活动报道）
Taking inspiration from her late mother's diaries, she at last found the courage to tell their family story. （读后续写·情感升华）

synonyms.example: The teacher's challenging question acted as a stimulus, waking curiosity that had long lain dormant. （议论文·教育）
synonyms.usage: stimulus 强调外部触发作用，较中性、偏客观；inspiration 更带创造性与情感激励色彩

synonyms.example: Her sole motivation was to lift her family out of poverty, and that goal kept her studying long past midnight. （读后续写·奋斗）
synonyms.usage: motivation 指驱使行动的内在原因/动力；inspiration 指激发创意或情感的启迪，侧重灵感来源

synonyms.translation: （艺术家的）灵感女神，创作灵感来源
synonyms.example: The bustling old town became his muse, filling sketchbook after sketchbook with life. （读后续写·艺术家）
synonyms.usage: muse 多用于文学/艺术语境，指具体的灵感对象或人格化的灵感；日常表达用 inspiration 更普遍

advancedExpressions.expression: it was from ... that she drew the inspiration to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was from her grandmother's weathered yet gentle hands that she drew the inspiration to keep the family craft alive. （强调句 It was...that + 细节意象，续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. has been a constant source of inspiration to ...

advancedExpressions.expression: inspiration favours the prepared mind
advancedExpressions.example: As Pasteur reminds us, inspiration favours the prepared mind; the spark of genius rarely lands on those who have not first done the patient work. （引名言+对比论证，说明灵感与努力的关系）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The story gave her inspiration to write.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The old man's story, rough and unpolished though it was, kindled in her a spark of inspiration so fierce that she could hardly wait to pour it onto the blank page before her. （读后续写·创作冲动）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 让步插入语(rough...though it was) + 动词升级(kindled a spark) + 程度状语从句(so fierce that...) + 画面收束(blank page)

sentenceUpgrade.original: He inspires many students.
